authorship: VJBot authored task criteria; not independently teacher-calibrated. Judge only the current question, not unasked production-task extras.

freestyle.question: こんにちは！今日はどんな一日でしたか？何か面白いことがありましたか？

requirements.description: Describe how your day went; an ordinary or uneventful day is valid.
Mention an event or explicitly say that nothing noteworthy happened.

freestyle.question: あなたの好きな日本のアニメや料理は何ですか？理由も教えてくださいね！

requirements.description: Name a Japanese anime or food you like, or state that you have no preference.
Give a reason for that preference or lack of preference.

combini.question: いらっしゃいませ！お弁当温めますか？

requirements.description: Clearly accept or decline having the bento warmed; either choice is valid.

combini.question: レジ袋はご利用になりますか？（一枚五円です）

requirements.description: Clearly accept or decline a shopping bag; either choice is valid.

ramen.question: 食券をお預かりします！麺のかたさはどうなさいますか？

requirements.description: Specify the noodle firmness you want, or say you have no preference.

practical:v1:N5:introductions.question: はじめまして。お名前とお仕事を教えてください。

requirements.description: State your name; accept any name or natural self-identification.
State your occupation or current student/employment status; unemployment and other truthful statuses are valid. Do not require hometown or a greeting not requested by this question.
Say what food or drink you want to order. Do not require two items, quantities or a price question unless the current question requests them.

practical:v1:N5:time.question: 何時から何時まで勉強しますか。いつ会いましょうか。

requirements.description: Give study start and end times.
Propose a meeting time after the study period, or explain another workable arrangement.

practical:v1:N5:transport.question: このバスについて、運転手に何を聞きますか。

requirements.description: Ask the driver to confirm the bus destination or whether it reaches your intended stop. Accept equivalent natural questions.

practical:v1:N5:shopping.question: いらっしゃいませ。何をお探しですか。

requirements.description: Identify an item you are looking for, or clearly say that you are only browsing. Do not require a price question or a particular counter.

practical:v1:N5:asking-help.question: わからない言葉があったら、どう聞きますか。

requirements.description: Ask about an unknown word or request clarification/repetition in a way that communicates what help is needed.

station.question: すみません、渋谷へ行きたいんですが、何番線に乗ればいいですか？

requirements.description: Answer with a platform or line for the requested trip, or honestly say you do not know. Do not invent verifiable route facts beyond the canonical context.

practical:v1:N4:late.question: 今どこですか。何時ごろ着きますか。

requirements.description: State your current location or honestly explain that it is uncertain.
Give an approximate arrival time or explicitly explain that the time is not yet known.

practical:v1:N4:leave.question: いつ休みたいですか。仕事の準備はどうしますか。

requirements.description: State when you want time off.
Explain how work will be prepared or handed over.

practical:v1:N4:clinic.question: 今日はどうしましたか。いつからですか。

requirements.description: Describe symptoms or the reason for the visit without inventing a diagnosis.
State when symptoms began or explicitly explain uncertainty about onset.

practical:v1:N4:booking.question: 何曜日の何時に、何名様でご予約ですか。

requirements.description: State the reservation day.
State the reservation time.
State the number of guests. Do not require an alternative time that was not asked for.

practical:v1:N4:instructions.question: 作業の順番を説明してください。わからないときはどうしますか。

requirements.description: Describe the work steps in the order supported by the canonical context. Equivalent wording is valid.
Explain how you would ask for help if something is unclear.

interview.question: 週に何日くらいシフトに入ることができますか？土日は働けますか？

requirements.description: State how many days per week you can work, or explicitly state that availability is not yet known.
Address weekend availability; accept any truthful yes/no/limited availability.

practical:v1:N3:repair.question: どんな故障ですか。いつ修理に伺えばよろしいですか。

requirements.description: Describe the malfunction or observed symptoms without asserting an unknown cause as fact.
Propose or communicate an acceptable repair visit time.

practical:v1:N3:scam.question: このメールを受け取ったら、どうやって本物か確認しますか。

requirements.description: Describe an independent verification route rather than trusting links or claims in the email.
Do not offer to disclose passwords or sensitive credentials as verification.

practical:v1:N3:handover.question: 在庫が不足していたら、どんな順番で対応しますか。

requirements.description: Explain the response order supported by the canonical context, including reporting the shortage before unauthorized ordering.
Explain what happens when stock is insufficient.

practical:v1:N3:interview.question: これまでの経験と、今できるようになったことを教えてください。

requirements.description: Describe past experience; having no prior experience is a valid truthful answer. Do not verify personal biography against invented facts.
Describe a concrete ability or improvement you have gained. Do not require an unasked future goal.

practical:v1:N2:policy.question: 資料室の規定で、例外として認められるのはどんな場合ですか。

requirements.description: Describe both exception conditions accurately from the canonical context.
Do not invent broader eligibility or extension rights not supported by the policy. Do not require the effective date unless needed to answer the question.

practical:v1:N2:comparison.question: どちらの印刷会社を選びますか。数字を使って理由を説明してください。

requirements.description: Clearly choose a printing company.
Support the choice with the canonical numerical cost and timing information relevant to the decision.

practical:v1:N2:proposal.question: 会議を減らす案について、利点とリスクをどう評価しますか。

requirements.description: Evaluate at least one benefit of reducing meetings.
Evaluate at least one risk, distinguishing expected effects from established facts.

practical:v1:N1:argument.question: 手続きの統一と例外的な支援は両立しますか。本文を踏まえて説明してください。

requirements.description: Explain how common procedures and exceptional support can coexist using the canonical text.
Preserve the text’s distinctions and qualify inferences; do not turn an example into a universal conclusion.

practical:v1:N1:synthesis.question: 研修の評価について、二人の共通点と相違点を説明してください。

requirements.description: Explain the two speakers’ common position about training evaluation.
Explain their differences while attributing claims to the correct speaker. Do not require an additional proposal not requested by the question.
